content.title: Step into Hannah Montana's closet in this immersive pop-up, coming to Los Angeles and New York - ABC7 Los Angeles
content.text: On The Red CarpetStep into Hannah Montana's closet in this immersive pop-upIn celebration of Disney's "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special," step inside Hannah's iconic closet!ByAmy Becker Friday, March 13, 2026Mockup for the "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary" x Maybelline pop-upsDISNEY/MAYBELLINELOS ANGELES -- You get the best of both worlds with this "Hannah Montana" pop-up!To celebrate the "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special," step into Hannah's iconic closet, where you can take home Maybelline products fit for a pop star and strike a pose at the Polaroid photo spot!The "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" premieres March 24 on Disney+ and Hulu.An RSVP is not required. It is a free event. First come, first serve.Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary x Maybelline Pop-ups:Los Angeles3/21-3/22The GroveAddress: 189 The Grove Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90036Time:Saturday March 21: 12pm - 8pmSunday March 22: 11am - 8pmNew York3/28-3/29The Atrium at Ideal Glass StudioAddress: 9 W 8th St, New York, NY 10011Time:Saturday March 28: 11am - 7pmSunday March 29: 10am - 7pmThe Walt Disney Company is the parent company of Disney+, Hulu and this ABC station.Report a correction or typoCopyright © 2026 OnTheRedCarpet.com.
